debrief db-021
row 1: the f-i-l-e-d c-l-a-i-m u-s-e-d f-a-c-t-i-t-i-o-u-s l-a-b-e-l i-t-e-m-s to m-i-m-i-c a p-r-o-d-u-c-t f-o-r-m a-t, s-l-i-p-p-i-n-g p-a-s-t t-r-i-a-g-e b-y r-e-a-d-i-n-g l-i-k-e a b-e-n-i-g-n c-a-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-e-t-a-t-a-g s-t-a-m-p-s i-n t-h-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e, f-l-a-g-g-e-d b-y c-r-o-s-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e w-i-t-h r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-s

row 2: the m-e-s-s-a-g-e f-r-a-m-e-d a n-e-e-d to r-e-l-a-b-e-l m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l as a r-o-u-t-i-n-e q-u-e-s-t, e-v-a-d-i-n-g i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e a-l-a-r-t, t-r-a-c-i-n-g t-o a r-e-p-e-a-t a-c-t-o-r i-d, c-a-u-g-h-t b-y b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r r-a-t-e l-i-m-i-t-s

row 3: the p-l-a-n t-o-t-a-l s-e-q-u-e-n-c-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s f-a-i-l-e-d i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l a-u-d-i-t l-o-g-s w-h-i-c-h s-h-o-w e-d-i-t-s w-i-t-h-o-u-t a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l, e-x-p-o-s-i-n-g t-h-e a-l-t-e-r a-t-i-o-n, d-e-t-e-c-t-e-d b-y l-i-n-e a-g-e m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g

row 4: the d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n p-a-t-h t-o-u-c-h-e-d f-i-v-e p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-o-d-e-s w-i-t-h-i-n o-n-e w-e-e-k, i-n-d-i-c-a-t-i-n-g a-b-n-o-r-m-a-l v-o-l-u-m-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-r-i-g-h-t-s w-h-i-t-e-l-i-s-t i-n-v-a-l-i-d a-t-t-e-m-p-t s-e-n-s-o-r r-e-a-d-i-n-g-s, c-l-e-a-r-l-y v-i-o-l-a-t-i-o-n o-f c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n r-u-l-e-s

row 5: the a-c-t-o-r o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e t-i-m-e s-t-a-m-p-s to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-t-e t-h-e g-a-p, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e l-o-g i-n-g s-t-e-p, t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m c-l-o-c-k d-r-i-f-t w-a-s l-o-g-g-e-d i-n t-h-e a-d-m-i-n t-r-a-c-e, r-e-v-e-a-l-i-n-g m-a-n-u-a-l t-a-l-l-y i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d t-i-m-e-v-a-l-u-e-s
